_note: Domain allowlist for legal-web-search. Adding a domain here is a deliberate, reviewable decision (edit this file directly) -- never silently accepted just because a search engine returned it. 'primary' = government-published source (the closest thing to an original text this project can reach without an official API). 'secondary' = commercial/aggregator legal-database sites that display a hiệu lực status but are not the government source itself -- useful for triangulation, never treated as more authoritative than a primary source when the two disagree.
